subject: Make some of RNA bases as DNA in leap

messages.author: Athena N
messages.body:
Dear all,
I have a 20 nt sequence of an RNA in which I want to make the nucleotides
4-7 as DNA. Is it possible to make this in Leap? Should I just change the
name of the bases from U as DT and A as DA and try to load them in Leap?
Thanking you in advance.
Athena

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Sep 28, 2020, Athena N wrote:
>Would the 2’-OH of the RNA read as H in such cases?
If you are reading in an RNA pdb file (this wasn't clear before) then
you should manually remove the O2' (and HO2') atoms for the residues
that will become DNA. Don't be afraid to experiment -- you could easily
find that the answer to your question is "no" just by trying it.
....dac
